artworks.title: The Birth of Venus
artworks.description: A celebrated Renaissance tempera painting showing the goddess of love arriving at the shore fully grown, borne on a scallop shell by the breath of the wind gods while a waiting Hora extends a flowered cloak. One of the most iconic images of Aphrodite ever made, it is housed in the Uffizi Gallery, Florence.

artworks.title: Venus de Milo
artworks.description: A Hellenistic marble statue generally identified as Aphrodite, discovered on the island of Melos in 1820. Renowned for its serene beauty and famously missing arms, it has become one of the defining images of the goddess and of classical sculpture itself. It is displayed at the Louvre, Paris.

artworks.title: Venus of Urbino
artworks.description: An oil painting of Venus reclining nude on a couch in a Venetian palace interior, her gaze meeting the viewer's with calm directness. Titian brings the goddess of love out of myth and into an intimate domestic setting, in an image that shaped centuries of reclining nudes. It hangs in the Uffizi Gallery, Florence.

artworks.title: The Birth of Venus
artworks.description: An academic oil painting of Venus newly born from the sea, reclining on the crest of a wave beneath a flight of putti. A sensation at the Paris Salon of 1863, where it was purchased by Napoleon III, it epitomizes the polished mythological nude of its era. It is now in the Musée d'Orsay, Paris.

films.title: Troy: Fall of a City
films.description: The BBC/Netflix Trojan cycle keeps Aphrodite in the Judgement that starts the war — the golden apple, the bribe of Helen, and the goddess whose vanity lights the pyre of Troy.

films.title: Clash of the Titans
films.description: Harryhausen's Olympus keeps Aphrodite among the gods who watch Perseus' quest — love's goddess as one voice in the divine gallery above the Kraken.

films.title: Hercules
films.description: Disney's Aphrodite is the blonde Olympian of romance — a cameo goddess in the pantheon that frames Hercules' rise from zero to hero.

films.title: Blood of Zeus
films.description: Netflix's myth cycle brings Aphrodite into the Olympian war — the goddess of love among the gods choosing sides as heaven burns.

music.title: The Golden Apple
music.description: Broadway's through-sung Homer pastiche gives Aphrodite the winning argument in the angel-food bake-off for the golden apple — love, as ever, taking the prize.

music.title: Venus and Adonis
music.description: Blow's court masque for Charles II is the earliest surviving English opera — Venus' love for the doomed huntsman sung as baroque pastoral tragedy.

music.title: Tannhäuser
music.description: Wagner's Venusberg opens on the goddess of love holding the minstrel in her mountain court — Aphrodite as Venus, the sensual temptation against which the opera's pilgrimage turns.

music.title: Il pomo d'oro
music.description: Cesti's Viennese extravaganza restages the Judgment of Paris: Venus wins the golden apple, and Aphrodite's prize becomes the engine of a fifty-scene baroque machine.

popCulture.title: Hades
popCulture.creator: Supergiant Games
popCulture.description: Aphrodite's boons in Supergiant's underworld run are charm and weak-point strike — the goddess of love as a build that makes enemies fall for you, then fall.

popCulture.title: Hades II
popCulture.creator: Supergiant Games
popCulture.description: She returns among the Olympian boon-givers in the sequel: the same velvet voice, now arming Melinoë's hunt for Chronos.

popCulture.title: Percy Jackson & the Olympians
popCulture.creator: Rick Riordan
popCulture.description: Riordan's Aphrodite is the goddess of love as mall-glamour and heartbreak — mother of Piper later, and the Olympian who judges demigods by their dating lives.

popCulture.title: God of War III
popCulture.creator: Santa Monica Studio
popCulture.description: Aphrodite appears in the chambers of Olympus as Kratos storms the gods — the goddess of love as a sensual waypoint in the Spartan's war on Zeus.
